recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast sepia-toned charcoal portrait of a smiling man integrated into a stylized nighttime cityscape with flat blue geometric buildings, white outlined clouds, and a crescent moon, all framed by bold, multi-layered vintage typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Sepia portrait as the central organic texture against flat graphic backgrounds
Blue geometric cityscape anchoring the bottom right corner
White puffy clouds with blue outlines framing the bottom left
Large-scale display type overlapping the top of the portrait
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia/brown tones for the human subject
Solid cobalt blue for architectural and sky elements
Thin blue outlines on white cloud shapes
High-contrast lighting on the facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait centered horizontally, slightly tilted, occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and smile of the sepia portrait serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red title at the top, moves down through the portrait's gaze, and settles on the geometric city and cloud base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White background at the top corners provides breathing room for metadata and logos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background and sepia-brown portrait tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cobalt blue used for the skyline and cloud outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Coral-red for the primary display title and deep purple for the secondary name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white background contrasts with mid-tone sepia and high-saturation blue.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or overlapping characters)
Thin stroke weights for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping 'OO' and 'LL' pairs to create a rhythmic pattern
Lowercase 'a' with a circular bowl and no spur
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Thin, airy uppercase display paired with heavy, grounded lowercase secondary text.
graphicDevices: Stylized cloud clusters with thick outlines

preserve: The contrast between thin and thick weights

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s geometric overlapping aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the clean geometric skeleton for the top title.
Matches the heavy, lowercase secondary text weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mixed-media illustration on a white background. Center a large, sepia-toned charcoal portrait of a smiling man with textured hair. In the bottom right, place a flat cobalt blue geometric skyline with a white crescent moon. In the bottom left, place white puffy clouds with thick cobalt blue outlines. Ensure the top area remains clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large title in a thin geometric sans-serif font across the top in coral-red, using negative tracking so letters overlap. Add a secondary name in the middle right using a heavy, bold lowercase sans-serif in deep purple, stacked vertically.

verificationChecks: Are the letters in the top title overlapping?
Is the portrait strictly sepia/brown tones?
Is the skyline a flat, solid cobalt blue?
Is the secondary text in a heavy, lowercase bold font?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector edges for the blue elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the sepia portrait doesn't bleed into the blue skyline colors.
Ensure the overlapping text remains legible despite the tight tracking.
Verify the cloud outlines are a consistent stroke weight.
Confirm the background is a clean, off-white or pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sepia Charcoal Portrait] + [Flat Geometric Blue Cityscape] + [Overlapping Geometric Sans Typography] on [White Background].
